messages:
Ari (PM): dropping frames for a new first-run surface — spotlight card vs horizontal carousel. fig: https://www.figma.com/file/spotlight/onboard-v4
Ari (PM): goal: higher activation on first-run without nagging repeat users. need copy + a11y notes + event names.

Bea (Designer): spotlight card is focused and supports one clear CTA; carousel surfaces more samples but can be skimmed. spotlight easier to localize.

Cal (Frontend): carousel needs lazy image loading and swipe support; spotlight is simpler. both need persisted dismissed state per workspace.

Dee (Devex): analytics plan: event=sample_surface_shown (spotlight|carousel), sample_clicked, sample_skipped, sample_dismissed_reason, experiment_id. will add gating on telemetry_consent.

Mina (A11y): quick checklist: small caption text fails contrast in dark theme — use semantic tokens; ensure keyboard users can tab to cards and carousel controls; announce new content with aria-live="polite"; for spotlight, set role="region" and a clear aria-label; close button needs visible label for screen readers.

Bea (Designer): copy options to test:
- Friendly: "Try a sample project — ~5 min" CTA: "Open sample"
- Energetic: "Spin up a demo" CTA: "Launch"
- Direct: "Start with a sample" CTA: "Use sample"
Which tone for first-run?

Ari (PM): prefer Friendly. include microcopy about what it showcases (chat / embeddings) and a tiny privacy note when keys are used. also add a small "5 min" tag.

Cal (Frontend): CSS snippet for spotlight card positioning:
```css
.spotlight { position: sticky; bottom: 16px; right: 16px; z-index: 60; }
```
Will ensure close button is first in DOM order for keyboard flow.

Mina (A11y): also recommend SR-only text: "Approximately five minutes to try this sample" and avoid using color alone for tags.

onboard-bot: reminder: run axe smoke + keyboard-nav tests before merge.

Ari (PM): action items: Bea update frames with friendly copy + contrast tokens; Cal open draft PR with DOM order + ARIA; Dee add events + feature flag; Mina review PR. target: Wed EOD for updated assets and draft PRs. :thumbsup:

Bea (Designer): will post updated frames tomorrow with mobile stacking and alt copy variants.

Cal (Frontend): drafting PR now; will include lazy-loading images for carousel variant.

Dee (Devex): added events to tracking doc and created flag sample_surface_variant.

Mina (A11y): will run a quick NVDA pass once PR is up.

Ari (PM): thanks team — we'll A/B for a small cohort after internal QA. ping here if blocked.
